source: NASA SMAP L4 Global 3-hourly 9 km EASE-Grid Surface and Root Zone Soil Moisture Geophysical Data (SPL4SMGP v008), variable land_evapotranspiration_flux
conversion: flux (kg m-2 s-1, 3-hourly time average) -> daily mean x 86400 s; 1 kg m-2 = 1 mm
meaning: Actual ET of the whole 9 km cell from the land model (rain-fed, no irrigation). Not a crop water requirement.

data_issues.negative_intervals_note: negative flux = dew/condensation, kept in the mean
